Alongside core methodological work, I collaborate across agricultural science, actuarial science, veterinary epidemiology, and financial/econometric time series. Recent projects include multivariate classification of stable isotope and trace-element profiles to verify grass-fed beef and dairy origin claims, quantifying the impact of polygenic risk scores on critical illness insurance, modelling dependent heteroskedastic time series, and prospective behavioural categorisation in animal science.
